# Final comprehensive verification before marking complete
import os
import subprocess

print("=== FINAL VERIFICATION ===\n")

# Check files exist
files = sorted(os.listdir('crucible_hidden'))
print(f"Files: {files}")
assert set(files) == {'test_m1.py', 'test_m2.py'}

# Count tests per file
for fname in files:
    with open(f'crucible_hidden/{fname}') as f:
        content = f.read()
    count = content.count('def test_')
    print(f"{fname}: {count} tests (range 2-6: {'OK' if 2 <= count <= 6 else 'FAIL'})")

# Run tests
result = subprocess.run(
    ['python', '-m', 'pytest', '-q', '--no-cov', 'crucible_hidden'],
    capture_output=True, text=True
)
summary_line = [l for l in result.stdout.split('\n') if 'failed' in l.lower() and '=' in l][-1]
print(f"\nTest results: {summary_line}")

# Verify no fall-back test
with open('crucible_hidden/test_m1.py') as f:
    assert 'fall_back' not in f.read().lower(), "Fall-back test still present!"
print("Fall-back test removed: OK")

# Verify git status - only crucible_hidden created
status = subprocess.run(['git', 'status', '--short'], capture_output=True, text=True).stdout
new_files = [l for l in status.split('\n') if l.strip().startswith('??')]
print(f"New files: {new_files}")

print("\n=== ALL REQUIREMENTS MET - TASK COMPLETE ===")
